description:
Role

The Acquisition.com Advisory Practice helps small and medium businesses navigate a multi-year journey. Marketing begins that relationship, and paid media is the front door. As Paid Acquisition Lead, you decide how paid dollars are allocated and are accountable for qualified leads and booked sales calls by channel and funnel.

You own cross-channel allocation, forecasting, account architecture and testing across Meta, Google Search, YouTube and emerging channels. This is a hands-on role: you build, run and scale campaigns yourself, while directing media-buying partners. You understand the journey from click to qualified lead, booked call, show and close, and use sales feedback to improve targeting and creative.

Responsibilities

  • Set monthly spend plans by channel and funnel, including floor, plan, ceiling and cost assumptions; reforecast weekly and explain forecast versus actual to leadership.

  • Build, optimize and scale Meta campaigns and step in to build and grow Google Search and YouTube accounts. Evaluate platforms on performance, and test new channels against a written plan, budget cap and stop criteria.

  • Optimize to qualified, callable leads and booked calls, not raw lead volume alone. Maintain a feedback loop with sales and SDRs on lead quality, booking and show rates.

  • Own a weekly creative testing cadence, maintain a library of winning angles and brief creative partners from account data.

  • Reconcile platform, attribution and CRM reporting weekly; maintain UTMs and channel scorecards and recommend what to scale, stop or test.

  • Work with media-buying vendors on budgets, performance and reporting. Set expectations, give feedback and step into the accounts when needed; manage tools within budget and document account structure, naming, UTMs, forecast models and operating standards.

  • Use AI to support forecasts, reconciliation, ad variants, fatigue and anomaly detection, and reporting. Partner with conversion optimization, lifecycle, sales and RevOps.

Requirements

  • Approximately 6–10 years in paid acquisition, including direct ownership of approximately $1M per month in Meta spend and personal experience building and managing accounts. Strong Google Ads capability is important as the Google program grows; equivalent platform experience is valuable.

  • Experience in direct-to-consumer or high-ticket B2B environments, with accountability for lead quality and downstream acquisition economics. Experience with leads that become booked calls or sales is especially relevant.

  • Fluency in cost per click, qualified lead, booked call, show and close; experience owning a monthly spend and volume forecast.

  • Hands-on experience with Meta and Google Ads, HubSpot, GA4, Hyros or comparable attribution, and iClosed or comparable booking tools.

  • Experience reconciling ad-platform, attribution and CRM results and explaining differences.

  • Demonstrable AI use in forecasting, deployment, variant generation, analysis or reporting.

  • Experience directing a buyer or analyst while remaining able to execute independently. Experience in education, coaching, events or other phone-sales businesses is a plus.

Results

  • Meta, Google Search and YouTube perform against agreed goals.

  • Cost per qualified lead and booked call is known by channel and funnel, reported weekly and held or improved as volume grows.

  • Leadership can make budget decisions from a maintained monthly forecast; workshop sales grow while blended acquisition cost improves.

  • Lead volume does not come at the expense of lead quality. Creative tests run on a documented weekly cadence.

  • New channels have written plans and stop criteria; AI increases deployment, analysis and testing throughput.

Location

  • Remote, USA

  • Some light travel to Las Vegas may be required

Compensation

  • $150,000-$180,000 base salary plus a 15% annual target bonus

  • The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise.

Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive, evolving benefits package designed to support your health, family, and wellbeing. Some key offerings:

  • Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off and Company-wide Holidays

  • Employer sponsored Medical, Dental, & Vision plans

    • $1,950 annual Employer HSA contribution

    • FSA options including dependent care

    • Employee assistance program and mental health resources

  • Employer match program for 401(k), eligible for both Traditional and Roth accounts

  • $1,200 annual wellness reimbursement through JOON that supports health, family care, pet care, fitness, and more!

  • For local or visiting team members, enjoy access to a state of the art gym at our HQ in Las Vegas

* Benefits eligibility applies only to full-time exempt roles.

ACQ Core Values:

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

Competitive Greatness

Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns.

Sincere Candor

Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally.

Unimpeachable Character

Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing.
